messages:
elaine: Staging just alerted: sudden 502s on /v1/embeds after the quant revert. Likely serializer header mismatch. Need a hotfix image and pin. Proposing `gcr.io/redwood/release/embed-fix:hot-2024-07-20`.

deploybot: Deploy request logged (ID=dr-2024-20). Approvals required: oncall + infra. Canary suggested: 5m. expedited=true.

mike: Oncall here, I can own monitoring. Blast radius in prod?

elaine: Staging ~4% of short-sequence embeds failing; prod path traffic ~0.6% but could amplify with retryers. Rollback triggers: error_rate delta >= 1.5% for 5m OR p95 > 850ms.

pat: Infra +1 for a 10m midwindow at 21:10 UTC. Need release doc link and configmap hash.

elaine: Canary ran 12m clean in staging after tweak. Release doc: https://docs.redwood.com/releases/embed-hotfix-2024-07-20 (one-liner: fix serializer header mismatch; pin image; rollback policy included). cfg-hash: `c4f1e7`.

elaine: Rollback snippet:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/embed-service embed=gcr.io/redwood/release/embed:2024-07-10
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/embed-service
```

deploybot: Expedited deploy scheduled: dr-2024-20 -> prod. Canary 5m then progressive rollout. Midwindow reserved 10m starting 1791240025. Monitors: embeds.error_rate, embeds.p95, kvcache.miss. Watchers: mike, pat, elaine.

ops-bot: Alerting ramp set 30s. Bound runbook: /runbooks/embed-serializer-hotfix. Pager: if error_rate > 1.5% for 5m -> page ops-lead and open incident.

mike: Oncall ACK. I'll watch graphs and trigger rollback + page #incidents if thresholds breach.

elaine: Thanks all 44d will post short blameless note after stabilization.
